title: Solaryn
description: A lightweight client-side modpack designed for SMP servers. Boosts FPS, reduces lag, and adds quality-of-life improvements all while staying fully vanilla-compatible and server-friendly.
body:
🌟 Modpack Description

Solaryn is a lightweight client-side modpack built for SMP servers.
It makes Minecraft smoother, faster, and more enjoyable — all without changing core gameplay or requiring the server to install anything.

✅ Boost Performance – higher FPS, reduced lag, faster chunk loading
✅ Multiplayer Ready – works on any SMP server, no server mods required
✅ Quality of Life – improved menus, keybinds, chat tools, and smoother UI
✅ Vanilla-Friendly – keeps gameplay the same, just better


---

💡 Why use it?

If you play on SMP servers, this pack gives you:

A lag-free experience in busy worlds

Clean visuals that don’t distract from multiplayer action

Compatibility with all server types (vanilla, Paper, Spigot, Fabric, Forge, etc.)

Optimizations for low-end and high-end PCs alike
